title: Content index manifest
description: Display order of the campaigns, scenarios or tutorials in the folder that holds this manifest.json.

$schema.title: Schema
$schema.description: Path or URL of the JSON Schema for this file, for editor autocomplete and errors. The client ignores it.

order.title: Display order
order.description: Folder names in the order they are shown. Items left out come after these, sorted by id.

items.title: Folder
items.description: Folder name of an item in this folder.
